project: Q-DUET-VLM rag-selector larger untouched utility replication

baseline.entry_point: frozen DPR Reader Top-5 over a newly hash-locked fixed Top-50 cohort
baseline.equivalence_test: Every future Reader score vector must replay the pinned Reader classifier and stable Top-5 before either frozen head is applied

core_invariants: Fresh questions are selected without answers, support labels, Reader scores or method outputs
All434 support-audit questions and the exposed100-case panel are excluded by exact question SHA-256
Wiki-DPR retrieval is frozen at Top-50 and never changed by the candidate
The cohort identity hash is frozen before Reader or head scoring
Only the already-frozen sequential quantum and matched-classical final parameters may be transported
Reviewers see no answer, score, rank, method identity or selection membership
A pass remains below L1/L2 until replicated utility and task-level evidence exist

interfaces.input_schema: frozen NQ validation interval, exact exclusion artifacts and frozen Wiki-DPR retrieval
interfaces.output_schema: hash-locked256x50 cohort followed by three comparable Top-5 selections and blind semantic utility

plugins.insertion_point: NQ validation population -> eligible unseen question identities
plugins.hypothesis: Exact exclusions plus a frozen hash ordering prevent exposed-question reuse and outcome-dependent sampling
plugins.input_schema: NQ questions and two hash-locked historical identity sources
plugins.resource_estimate: 3610 question records and two small historical identity artifacts

emitted_fields: all selected and excluded identity counts

plugins.insertion_point: selected fresh questions -> fixed retrieval candidates
plugins.hypothesis: A fixed provenance-locked Top-50 cohort can be exported without any selector or semantic target
plugins.input_schema: 256 questions, pinned DPR query encoder and Wiki-DPR index configuration
plugins.output_schema: 256 ordered lists of50 passage ids, titles, texts and retrieval scores
plugins.resource_estimate: 256 query encodings and Wiki-DPR Top-50 lookups

plugins.insertion_point: hash-locked fresh Top-50 -> frozen Reader and already-fitted heads
plugins.hypothesis: The validation87 positive direction repeats on a larger identity-disjoint cohort and remains better than the matched classical head
plugins.input_schema: frozen cohort, pinned Reader and frozen sequential head parameters
plugins.output_schema: three complete256x50 score matrices and Top-5 sets
plugins.resource_estimate: 12800 frozen Reader passages plus small fixed-head forwards

output_fields: identity, quantum and classical scores and Top-5
emitted_fields: complete numeric states and all selections

composition.merge_rule: Question identities and Top-50 are frozen before any method score exists; all scoring arms share exact inputs

validation.baseline_equivalence: Pinned Reader scores and Top-5 replay on every fresh case before head comparison

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation pool[512:3610], deterministic unseen hash sample256, exact434+100 exclusions
reproducibility.environment: collaborator data-bearing environment for cohort export; bound gpu-training host only after cohort hash freeze

trace_contract.sample_selection_rule: first256 eligible identities after frozen SHA256 ordering of nq_open validation[512:3610]
trace_contract.target_boundary: no answers, support/Silver labels, Reader scores or selector outputs during cohort export
producer_owned_lineage: NQ identity -> exact exclusion -> frozen hash order -> Wiki-DPR Top-50 -> cohort identity lock

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Before semantic review, at least25/256 quantum Top-5 changes and15/256 quantum/classical differences on a cohort frozen before scoring

limitations: The256-case cohort is a larger untouched replication, not the full dataset
Cohort export alone contains no utility evidence
A matched-classical difference is attribution viability, not quantum advantage
The plugin plan stays approved rather than implemented until a real trace fixture and later transport replay pass
